title: USG Executive Branch: Summary
text:
USG Executive Branch: Summary

What it does: The USG Executive Branch is the overseeing body of the Undergraduate Student Government. It includes the elected President, the Vice President, the Chief of Staff, and the Executive Cabinet, which oversees USG's departments. It also contains the Communications, Programming, and Funding departments.

Executive Cabinet (2025-26 term, as listed on the page): President; Vice President; Chief of Staff; Chief Financial Officer; Chief Communications Officer; Chief Programming Officer; Chief Diversity Officer; Speaker of the Senate.

Departments (per site navigation): Communications; Funding; Programming; Advocacy.

Resources and services (menu categories only; the page does not describe the programs): Emergency Contacts; Financial Support; Advocacy & Academic Support; Health and Wellness Support; Get Involved.

Documents: Constitution; Bylaws; Office Hours & Staff Roster; Brand Guidelines.

Contact: USC Undergraduate Student Government, 3607 Trousdale Pkwy, SKS 404, Los Angeles, California 90089. Email: usg@usc.edu.

Dates and deadlines: The only date listed is the 2025-26 Executive Cabinet term. The page has no event dates or application deadlines.
